chunkSchedules.algorithm: Use strictly increasing interior byte cut offsets. Add a cut before every BEL or ESC byte, after every ESC byte, before every UTF-8 continuation byte, and both before and after every CSI final byte in 0x40..0x7E after ESC '['. The final input-size boundary is implicit and forbidden in cutOffsets. Duplicate offsets collapse.

generatedPerformancePayload.algorithm: Cycle fixture input payloads in this exact order: alternate-screen-roundtrip, color-style-matrix, synchronized-output, unicode-grapheme-wide, write-response-order. After each complete payload append ASCII '#' plus the zero-based unsigned 64-bit record counter as exactly 16 lowercase hexadecimal digits plus LF. Append a complete payload+suffix only when it fits. Fill the final remainder, if any, only with ASCII 'x' bytes. The result is exactly 8388608 bytes and never truncates a fixture escape or UTF-8 sequence.
